why_ai: Technicians climb poles and enter homes to keep a physical network running, and demand for connectivity grows with AI, but no licence or relationship protects the operator.
why_clarity: Speed, uptime and repeat calls are measured objectively across millions of near-identical subscriptions, though fault diagnosis is still tacit.
why_digital: Work starts from physical plant and telemetry and ends in an online service, but the provider is fixed by who has wires at the address.

why_ai: Repairs happen on poles and in pedestals, and locating intermittent shared faults stays ambiguous, though the analysis layer is automatable.
why_clarity: A fault is cleared or not within days, but the diagnosis is done by feel and resolution records are noisy.
why_digital: Telemetry in and analysis on screens, but the value is delivered as a physical repair by local crews.

why_ai: Offer targeting is substitutable by models, while copper migrations still need installs and careful handling of customers.
why_clarity: Retained or lost is measurable on recurring cohorts, but the effect of an offer is rarely measured with a holdout.
why_digital: Account and availability data in, decisions and outreach delivered remotely, with some in-home migration work.

why_ai: Pricing save offers is a data decision that uplift models and agents can take over; the save conversation is the last human part.
why_clarity: Monthly roll-off cohorts repeat with a clear retained-or-lost outcome, measurable within a quarter given a holdout.
why_digital: Billing, usage and address data in, offers delivered by phone, text or online.

why_ai: Each migration ends in an install or device swap at the premises, under regulator notice rules.
why_clarity: Every line has a clear migrated, lost or failed outcome against a wire-center date.
why_digital: Line inventories and plans are digital; the migration itself is delivered in person.

why_ai: Evidence assembly is mechanical and automatable, though an officer or engineer certifies and the carrier carries clawback risk.
why_clarity: Each location either meets its milestone with evidence or not, on recurring federal and state schedules.
why_digital: Location data and evidence in, uploads and reports delivered through regulator portals.

why_ai: Keeping the record true needs someone to open closures and verify in the field, and operators will keep needing it.
why_clarity: A record either matches the splices in the closure or it does not, and every job can check it.
why_digital: Photos, traces and maps on screens, with field verification and local records staff.

why_ai: Serving first-time operators means running networks and installs for a community that buys on trust and local presence.
why_clarity: Take rate is measurable, but it arrives over years and depends on many local factors.
why_digital: Mixed: planning and billing on screens, construction, installs and member relations in person and local.

why_ai: Plan matching and dunning are data decisions open to automation, constrained by fairness and eligibility rules.
why_clarity: Disconnect or stay is observable within months across many similar accounts.
why_digital: Account and eligibility data in, plans and outreach delivered remotely, with some in-person assistance.

why_ai: The reconciliation is mechanical and replaceable by software; an engineer still certifies the result.
why_clarity: A codified FCC specification, the same filing every six months, checked by the system and by challenges.
why_digital: Records in, a filing out, done entirely on screens and often by remote consultants.

why_ai: Order handling and activation are being automated end to end; only some installs still need a technician.
why_clarity: An order either becomes working service or not, immediately and in huge volume.
why_digital: Orders and records in, activation delivered online, with a share of installs in person.

why_ai: Clients hire named consultants with funding track records, and each community's build case is a judgement call, though drafting is automatable.
why_clarity: Applications follow agency rules, but each study is bespoke and its forecast is tested years later.
why_digital: Public data and client records in, studies and applications delivered digitally to clients found by referral.

why_ai: Estimates built mainly from public filings face direct substitution by AI-generated analysis.
why_clarity: Quarterly series recur on the earnings calendar and are checked against reported numbers.
why_digital: Filings and surveys in, databases and reports sold online.

why_ai: Rule-bound studies are automatable, but carriers rely on specialists who defend filings before regulators.
why_clarity: Codified separations rules, annual repetition and regulator acceptance as the check.
why_digital: Carrier books in, filings out, done on screens for clients chosen by relationship.

why_ai: The corpus is unique and demand for independent measurement persists, but the analysis is software-driven.
why_clarity: Measurements and benchmarks recur continuously with objective metrics.
why_digital: Device measurements in, datasets and reports delivered online worldwide.

why_ai: A trusted national dataset held under federal contract is hard to displace, though production is automatable.
why_clarity: Each location is checkable and challenges grade the dataset every six months.
why_digital: Parcel, address and imagery data in, licensed datasets delivered online.

why_ai: Award brands carry trust with consumers, but survey analysis is readily automated.
why_clarity: A fixed annual study design repeated each year with clear scores.
why_digital: Survey data in, studies and licences delivered online.

why_ai: Statutory authority to award and claw back subsidies stays with accountable public officials.
why_clarity: Programme rules are codified, but whether funded networks deliver is known years later.
why_digital: Applications and evidence handled on screens by public bodies serving their own jurisdiction.

why_ai: Analytics bundled into SaaS are the most automatable layer, and operators can build or swap them.
why_clarity: Dashboards and models recur across operators with measurable network and marketing outcomes.
why_digital: Device telemetry in, cloud software delivered remotely.

why_ai: Credit decisions carry accountability and rely on long relationships with rural borrowers.
why_clarity: Loan terms are defined, but whether a build repays is known only after years.
why_digital: Financials on screens, with site visits and relationships with regional borrowers.

why_ai: Market selection and acquisitions are novel, high-stakes judgements made by trusted executives.
why_clarity: Each deal is one-off and its outcome is known years later.
why_digital: Data rooms and models on screens, with negotiation and diligence in person.

why_ai: Specification work and lab testing need engineers solving novel problems for members.
why_clarity: Specs are precise, but research projects are one-off with slow validation.
why_digital: Technical work in labs and on screens, delivered as documents and events to members.

why_ai: Member surveys are easily automated; the association's advocacy relationships are what members pay for.
why_clarity: Annual surveys repeat, but their purpose is advocacy rather than a checkable result.
why_digital: Survey data in, reports published online for members.

why_ai: Pole inventories need field crews and rate disputes need expert testimony before commissions.
why_clarity: Inventories are checkable, but rate outcomes depend on contested proceedings.
why_digital: Field surveys and filings, delivered digitally to regional clients.

why_ai: Fee audits are rule-bound and automatable, though municipalities hire known specialists.
why_clarity: Fees owed under a franchise agreement are calculable and auditable.
why_digital: Operator records in, audit reports delivered digitally to municipal clients.

why_ai: Policy research from public data is substitutable by AI; funders pay for credibility and convening.
why_clarity: Studies are one-off and their policy effect is hard to measure.
why_digital: Public data and surveys in, research published online.

why_ai: Tariff and pool calculations follow FCC rules and are automatable, though NECA files and answers for them before the FCC.
why_clarity: Codified cost and settlement rules, the same annual tariff cycle, and FCC review as the check.
why_digital: Member cost and demand data in, tariffs and settlements out, all on screens for a fixed membership.
